sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri dbp:trailheads res:Grand_Canyon FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?uri dbp:hazards res:Flash_flood } }

question: Which book has the most pages?
sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type dbo:Book ; dbo:numberOfPages ?n } ORDER BY DESC(?n) OFFSET 0 LIMIT 1

question: What is the largest state in the United States?
sparql: SELECT ?uri WHERE { ?uri dct:subject dbc:States_of_the_United_States ; rdf:type dbo:AdministrativeRegion ; dbo:areaTotal ?area } ORDER BY DESC(?area) OFFSET 0 LIMIT 1

question: Give me the websites of companies with more than 500000 employees.
sparql: SELECT distinct ?web WHERE { ?sub dbo:numberOfEmployees ?obj . ?sub foaf:homepage ?web FILTER( xsd:integer(?obj) > 500000 ) . }

question: What were the names of the three ships by Columbus?
sparql: SELECT ?uri WHERE { ?uri rdf:type dbo:Ship ; dct:subject dbc:Christopher_Columbus ; dct:subject dbc:Exploration_ships }
